name: GetKpiSummary
description: Get aggregated KPI dashboard from SAP: total revenue, order count, fulfillment rate, cancellation rate, and revenue time series. Trigger when user asks about overall performance, KPI overview, revenue totals, sales dashboard, or period-level analytics. All params optional — call immediately on intent match.

fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

salesOrg.description: Sales org filter. Null if not specified.

granularity.description: Time breakdown granularity for revenue series. Values: 'daily' (theo ngày), 'weekly' (theo tuần), 'monthly' (theo tháng). Null if user does not specify.
